criteria.reason: Bound/unbound, cross-session isolation, repeated notice, unavailable task and runtime-evidence-change cases pass. Stop reuses assess and emits only advisory systemMessage; no continuation or completion mutation.
Interrupt metadata excludes prompt/tool payload, resume lists its path, and held-lock regression now records independently. Native Interrupt activation is outside this local contract claim.

Changed file inventories, config selection, deduplication, stale-during-check and findings sanitization pass. Separate actual stdin smoke called real doctor/agent-config without configured app tests, install, network or model calls.
Remote command/options/local redirect, upload vs download, and SFTP batch matrices pass without executing remote commands. Unknown grammar remains undecided and is documented as an auxiliary guard.

All six event definitions and CLI/stdin contracts pass. UserPromptSubmit remains absent. Static checks validate instruction/context/docs links; the central hooks guide states native trust and unsupported-path limitations.

limitations: Author self-review, not independent security assessment
Native host event activation and /hooks trust approval not verified or modified
Recognized command classifier is not a complete shell/security boundary; callback errors and unobserved tools may bypass it
Product UI unchanged; browser E2E not applicable. One existing process-group cleanup subcase was skipped because the execution sandbox denies group signals.

verification.scope: All four authorized lifecycle behaviors, session/private metadata boundaries, official event output shape, local regression and document consumers.
